description: Na₃BiF₆ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a linear geometry to two equivalent F atoms. Both Na-F bond lengths are 2.08 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.18 Å) and two longer (2.19 Å) Na-F bond lengths. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a square co-planar geometry to four F atoms. There are two shorter (2.26 Å) and two longer (2.34 Å) Na-F bond lengths. Bi is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Bi-F bond distances ranging from 2.27-2.32 Å. There are three inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to two Na and one Bi atom. In the second F site, F is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Na and one Bi atom. In the third F site, F is bonded in a T-shaped geometry to two Na and one Bi atom.
